gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.same_p: The secondary path must differ from the primary.

gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.second: Your secondary path opens at your first milestone.
gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.shard_: That shard row hasn't opened yet.
gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.in_com: In combat: changes wait until the fight ends.
gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.no_cha: Changing a rune needs Rune Chalk.
gui.ascension_combat.rune_refused.no_lev: Changing a rune needs more experience levels.
rune.ascension_combat.conquerors_resolve: Every second in a fight you gain a stack. They clear when the fight ends.
rune.ascension_combat.relentless_strikes: Hits build a stack that fades if you stop; each stack adds damage to every hit.
rune.ascension_combat.second_wind.desc: Regenerate while in combat and below half health.
rune.ascension_combat.killing_surge.desc: A kill gives a short burst of attack speed.
rune.ascension_combat.cadence.desc: Land fully charged hits on one enemy, one after another. The last one hits harder and Exposes the enemy: it takes more damage from everyone.
rune.ascension_combat.vein_breaker.desc: Mine an ore or a log while sneaking and the connected blocks of the same kind break with it. Each one wears your tool and costs a little hunger.
rune.ascension_combat.blooded.desc: Omnivamp that grows with every new kind of enemy you defeat. Swap it out and it starts again.
rune.ascension_combat.giant_slayer.desc: You deal more damage to enemies with more max HP than you. Bosses most of all.
enchantment.ascension_combat.soulbound.d: Keeps this item when you die.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Repairs this item with experience, at half the usual rate.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: More damage to spiders and insects.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: More damage the further you fall onto a target.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc: Your lungs hold 10 more seconds of air for each level.
enchantment.ascension_combat.keen_edge.d: Your hits ignore some of the target's Armor.
enchantment.ascension_combat.leech.desc: You heal for a share of the damage you deal.
enchantment.ascension_combat.warding.des: Protects you from magic damage. Cannot be combined with Protection.
At an anvil with an enchanted item: wipes every enchantment off it.
item.ascension_combat.tome_of_extraction: In a crafting grid with an enchanted item and a book: moves every enchantment onto the book.
rune.ascension_combat.momentum.desc: Chaining hits quickly builds stacks; each heals you for a share of the damage you deal.
rune.ascension_combat.momentum.n1: %s of the damage you deal, healed, a stack
rune.ascension_combat.momentum.n2: %s seconds to chain the next hit
rune.ascension_combat.blooded.n0: +%s%% omnivamp for each kind of enemy
rune.ascension_combat.giant_slayer.n0: %s damage to enemies with %s more max HP
rune.ascension_combat.conquerors_resolve: Every second in a fight: more Attack Damage and healing, until it ends.
rune.ascension_combat.cadence.blurb: A run of charged hits on one enemy ends in a hard hit that Exposes it.
rune.ascension_combat.vein_breaker.blurb: Sneak and mine: the connected ore or logs break with it.
gui.ascension_combat.pick_keystone: Choose a keystone from the three on your dial.
gui.ascension_combat.lose_growth: Swapping out %s throws away its growth: %s of %s kinds.
gui.ascension_combat.card.free: An empty place: free to fill.
gui.ascension_combat.card.swap: Swapping %s for it costs %s Rune Chalk and %s levels.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_offence_atta: A small, plain boost to Attack Damage.
A small, plain boost to Attack Speed.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_offence_move: A small, plain boost to Move Speed.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_flex_attack_: A small, plain boost to Attack Damage.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_flex_armor.d: A small, plain boost to Armor.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_flex_magic_r: A small, plain boost to Magic Resist.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_defence_heal: A small, plain boost to Health.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_defence_armo: A small, plain boost to Armor.
rune.ascension_combat.shard_defence_magi: A small, plain boost to Magic Resist.
rune.ascension_combat.ambush.desc: Hits on an enemy that isn't targeting you deal much more damage, more still if critical. Sneak up on things. Bosses always see you.
rune.ascension_combat.ambush.blurb: Hit an enemy that has not seen you for far more damage.
rune.ascension_combat.ambush.n0: %s damage to an enemy that isn't targeting you
rune.ascension_combat.ambush.n1: %s more damage on a critical hit
rune.ascension_combat.deadeye.desc: Ranged hits deal more damage the farther away the enemy is. Hit the head and they deal a lot more, with a chime and a flash.
rune.ascension_combat.deadeye.blurb: Ranged hits hurt more from afar, and more still to the head.
rune.ascension_combat.deadeye.n0: %s damage for a hit to the head
rune.ascension_combat.deadeye.n1: %s damage for each block of distance past %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.silent_step.desc: You make no vibrations: sculk sensors and shriekers never hear you, so the Warden isn't called. While you sneak, mobs only notice you up close.
rune.ascension_combat.silent_step.blurb: You make no vibrations; sneaking, mobs notice you only up close.
rune.ascension_combat.silent_step.n0: While sneaking, mobs notice you only within %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.pounce.desc: Your critical hits, from a fall, hit harder.
rune.ascension_combat.pounce.n0: Critical hits deal ×%s damage instead of ×1.5
rune.ascension_combat.drop_in.desc: For a few seconds after a dash, a blink, an ender pearl or a long fall, you cut through armour.
rune.ascension_combat.drop_in.n1: For %s seconds after a dash, blink, ender pearl or a fall of %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.vanish.desc: Killing an enemy makes you invisible, as with a potion of invisibility, for a couple of seconds. Mobs lose track of you and cannot pick you out until it ends.
rune.ascension_combat.vanish.n0: Invisible for %s seconds after a kill
rune.ascension_combat.finishing_blow.des: More damage to enemies that are nearly dead.
rune.ascension_combat.overkill.desc: Damage beyond what a kill needed splashes onto the nearest enemy.
rune.ascension_combat.overkill.n0: Up to %s damage splashes to the nearest enemy within %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.trophy_hunter.desc: Lethality that grows with every new kind of enemy you defeat. Swap it out and it starts again.
rune.ascension_combat.trophy_hunter.n0: %s Lethality for each kind of enemy
rune.ascension_combat.starfall.desc: A fully charged hit, or any magic damage you deal, calls a star down on the target. It lands a moment later and hurts everything near it. Magic hits shorten its cooldown.
rune.ascension_combat.starfall.blurb: Charged hits and magic call a falling star down on the target.
rune.ascension_combat.starfall.n0: %s + %s of your Attack Damage as magic damage
rune.ascension_combat.starfall.n2: %s second cooldown, %s second less for each magic hit
rune.ascension_combat.arc.desc: Every few hits charge your weapon. The next hit releases lightning that jumps between enemies. Using an item's active charges it at once.
rune.ascension_combat.arc.blurb: Every fourth hit throws lightning that jumps between enemies.
rune.ascension_combat.arc.n1: %s + %s of your Attack Damage as magic damage
rune.ascension_combat.arc.n2: Jumps up to %s times within %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.scholar.desc: More experience from everything, and enchanting costs a level less.
rune.ascension_combat.scholar.blurb: More experience from everything; enchanting costs a level less.
rune.ascension_combat.scholar.n1: Enchanting costs %s level less, never below 1
rune.ascension_combat.attunement.desc: All your magic damage is stronger.
rune.ascension_combat.unweave.desc: Your magic damage ignores part of the target's Magic Resist.
rune.ascension_combat.clarity.desc: While you are healthy, more Attack Damage and more magic damage.
rune.ascension_combat.siphon.desc: You heal for part of the magic damage you deal.
rune.ascension_combat.siphon.n0: Heal for %s of the magic damage you deal
rune.ascension_combat.gathering_charge.d: Magic damage that grows with every new kind of enemy you defeat. Swap it out and it starts again.
rune.ascension_combat.gathering_charge.n: %s magic damage for each kind of enemy
rune.ascension_combat.brace.desc: Block a hit with a shield, or take a big hit, and you brace: huge defences for a moment, then a shockwave that hurts and throws back everything near you.
rune.ascension_combat.brace.blurb: Block or take a big hit: huge defences, then a shockwave.
rune.ascension_combat.brace.n0: Block a hit with a shield, or take a hit of %s of your max health
rune.ascension_combat.brace.n1: %s Armor and Magic Resist for %s seconds
rune.ascension_combat.brace.n2: Then a shockwave: %s + %s of your Armor as magic damage, within %s blocks
rune.ascension_combat.pack_leader.desc: Your tamed wolves, cats and parrots share your defences, hit harder, and heal when you heal. Now and then a pet that would die is saved and brought to you.
rune.ascension_combat.pack_leader.blurb: Your pets share your defences, hit harder, and heal with you.
rune.ascension_combat.pack_leader.n0: Pets share %s of your Armor and Magic Resist
rune.ascension_combat.pack_leader.n2: Pets heal for %s of what you heal
rune.ascension_combat.pack_leader.n3: A pet that would die is saved once every %s seconds
rune.ascension_combat.cats_eye.desc: Creepers and phantoms keep away from you, as they do from cats. The price: creepers are hard to hunt for gunpowder.
rune.ascension_combat.cats_eye.blurb: Creepers and phantoms keep away from you, as they do from cats.
rune.ascension_combat.cats_eye.n0: Creepers flee within %s blocks; phantoms never swoop at you
rune.ascension_combat.plating.desc: After a hard hit, the next few hits are softened for a moment.
rune.ascension_combat.plating.n0: After a hit of %s or more, the next %s hits within %s seconds take %s less damage
rune.ascension_combat.unbowed.desc: Harmful effects on you wear off sooner, and knockback moves you less.
rune.ascension_combat.deep_roots.desc: Max health that grows with every new kind of enemy you defeat. Swap it out and it starts again.
rune.ascension_combat.deep_roots.n0: %s Health for each kind of enemy
rune.ascension_combat.riposte.desc: Raise your shield just as a hit lands: the attacker is stunned and your next hit is a critical.
rune.ascension_combat.riposte.n0: Raise your shield within %s seconds of the hit to parry
rune.ascension_combat.riposte.n1: Stuns the attacker for %s second; bosses cannot be stunned
rune.ascension_combat.riposte.n2: Your next hit within %s seconds is a critical hit
rune.ascension_combat.revitalize.desc: Heals and shields you receive are stronger, more so when you are low.
rune.ascension_combat.challenge.desc: Mobs you hit keep attacking you instead of your allies, your pets or the villagers.
rune.ascension_combat.challenge.n0: Mobs you hit keep attacking you for %s seconds
